inventory.public_api: ByteLanguageModelConfig(..., chunked_lm_head_v2=True); default False preserves existing profile and nine-field ABI.
inventory.configuration_contract: 7/9 legacy native shape integers remain accepted; optional tenth integer is exactly0/1. Python serialized config gains strict boolean field and accepts older dictionaries without it. Profile includes existing -lmhead-chunk256-v2 marker, which names arithmetic, not selected storage-panel width. IDENTICAL only; vocab>=2.
inventory.numeric_contract: Selected neural GEMM logits; global ascending vocabulary maximum/denominator and dHidden FMA chains; ascending row dWeight FMA chain; existing v2 loss leaves256 and fixed pair tree. Same host/device panel selector. The separately public scalar-logit chunked head oracle is preserved and is not used as this model's wide-K oracle.
inventory.workspace_contract: One bounded rows*min(vocab,panel) logits panel plus row statistics. GEMM scratch is max of actual full-panel and final-tail dispatcher requirements. Local device loss-fold buffers now wait for their raw-pointer consumers on success/error before release. Full model parameters, gradient outputs and transformer state remain owned as before.
inventory.inference_contract: Full-vocabulary logits remain full selected-GEMM outputs; chunked choice governs training/loss storage and gradient profile, not output cardinality.
remaining_integration_limitations: New selected host loss uses the normative block-hidden composition; host task scheduling performance is unmeasured.
Full workload corpus hash, shapes, model settings, cold/repeated boundaries and all quality/performance evidence remain future work.
No source-only claim of compilation, bitwise identity, quality or performance.
